archetype: Melee STR pirate built on a skill-linking system: attacks chain into one another with no end-lag as long as you alternate inputs, and the core damage loop is alternating two main attacks. Sustained DPM class with very high mobility and strong boss uptime tools rather than one large burst window, though 6th job added a stronger 2 minute burst, an over-shield and an Origin skill. Party utility is limited to an attack speed buff.

linkSkill.name: Cygnus Blessing
linkSkill.effect: Shared Cygnus Knights link skill. Grants flat Attack Power and Magic ATT plus Abnormal Status Resistance and All Elemental Resistance. Stacks up to 5 times, once per unique Cygnus Knights job character on the world.
linkSkill.levels: maplestorywiki.net Thunder_Breaker/Skills: Lv1 = ATT and MATT +7, Abnormal Status Resistance +1, All Elemental Resistance +1%; max level = ATT and MATT +35, Abnormal Status Resistance +22, All Elemental Resistance +22%. Grandis Library states the same max values and adds that Mihile is excluded from the 5-character stack.

vMatrix.notes: Boost node groupings as published by maplestorywiki (game data, no judgement attached), which Grandis Library reproduces: Core 1 = Annihilate Boost; Core 2 = Thunderbolt Boost; Core 3 = Gale Boost and Deep Rising Boost; Core 4 = Tidal Crash Boost, Sea Wave Boost, Shark Sweep Boost; Core 5 = Thunder Boost and Ascension Boost; Core 6 = Flash Boost and Lightning Punch Boost. Grandis Library tiers these as PRIMARY (Annihilate; Thunderbolt), SECONDARY (Gale/Typhoon/Deep Rising; Tidal Crash/Sea Wave/Shark Sweep) and OTHER (Ascension/Thunder; Flash/Lightning Punch), and says Primary and Secondary are the ones worth upgrading. Boost node level cap is 60. maplestorywiki lists final damage per level by skill: Lightning Punch and Flash boosts highest at 7% per level, Shark Sweep / Tidal Crash / Sea Wave at 5%, Ascension / Thunder at 3%, and Gale / Annihilate / Thunderbolt / Deep Rising lowest at 2% but with extra effects at levels 20 and 40 (max targets, ignore DEF, critical rate). Sources: https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Thunder_Breaker/Skills and https://grandislibrary.com/cygnus-knights/thunder-breaker

hexa.notes: Node inventory validated against maplestorywiki so nothing here is invented. Skill Nodes: Core 1 (Origin) = Thunder Wall Sea Wave; Core 2 (Ascent) = Annihilating Rush. Mastery Nodes: Core 1 = HEXA Annihilate (also raises Thunder Bolt); Core 2 = HEXA Thunderbolt; Core 3 = HEXA Typhoon and HEXA Deep Rising; Core 4 = HEXA Sea Wave (also raises Deep Reinforcement). HEXA Enhancement (boost) nodes: Lightning Cascade Boost, Shark Torpedo Boost, Lightning God Spear Strike Boost, Lightning Spear Multistrike Boost - all level requirement 260, master level 30, final damage rising linearly with jumps at levels 10, 20 and 30. HEXA Phalanx Charge was added in v.271 and is not yet on the maplestorywiki skills page that was read; the class doc records it as a level 30 skill and quotes MapleScouter figures of roughly +0.42% final damage at level 1, +1.18% at 10, +2.00% at 20 and +2.86% at 30. HEXA Stat node unlocks per the class doc: node I at Lv 260 for 5 Sol Erda and 10 fragments, node II at Lv 265 for 10 Sol Erda and 200 fragments, node III at Lv 270 for 15 Sol Erda and 350 fragments; resets cost 10m, 20m and 35m mesos respectively. The doc also flags a KMS change (v.1.2.417 MapleStory Overdrive, 2026-07-31) adding a third HEXA skill core, Sea Emperor Smash, worth roughly 2.5-3% final damage at level 30 - not in GMS as of v.271, so any HEXA order will shift when it arrives. Sources: https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Thunder_Breaker/Skills and https://docs.google.com/document/d/149bORdBFd99UJSFbza52zv5AJw4VfB4kvqC5p4K-97g/mobilebasic
hexa.noteOnCharacterLevel154: At Lv 154 none of this is reachable yet - 5th job and the V Matrix begin at 200, 6th job and the HEXA Matrix at 260. The actionable items at this level are the hyper skill passives (from Lv 140) and hyper stats.

hyperStats.notes: NOT SOURCED. The Thunder Breaker class doc has no hyper stat section at all, and Grandis Library publishes no hyper stat allocation for any class. No independent Thunder Breaker hyper stat ranking was found in this pass. Two sourced facts bear on it: Thunder Breaker gains +40% critical rate and +30% critical damage from its own passives and 0% boss damage from passives (Grandis Library base-stats-from-skills table), and the class doc says a Thunder Breaker short on critical rate early should use the Xenon link and may swap in Lynn or Phantom links as needed. The doc's Legion Grid ranking - critical rate as needed, then boss damage, critical damage, ignore DEF, STR, attack power, buff duration (only when running the Angelic Buster link), DEX - is a LEGION recommendation, not a hyper stat one, and must not be relabelled as hyper stats. The community's operative answer to hyper stat priority is MathBro's per-character optimizer at https://brendonmay.github.io/hyperCalculator/, not a fixed list. Sources: https://docs.google.com/document/d/149bORdBFd99UJSFbza52zv5AJw4VfB4kvqC5p4K-97g/mobilebasic and https://grandislibrary.com/cygnus-knights/thunder-breaker

hyperSkills.notes: The full hyper passive pool per maplestorywiki is Gale - Reinforce / Spread / Extra Strike, Thunderbolt - Reinforce / Spread / Extra Strike and Annihilate - Reinforce / Guardbreak / Boss Rush; the five recommended above are chosen from those nine. Two class hyper skills sit outside the passive pool and matter because the doc's rotation is built on them: Primal Bolt (Lv 140) removes the Gale/Typhoon cooldown for its duration, raises Lightning Elemental's ignore DEF from 45% to 50%, and shortens the cooldowns of Sea Wave, Shark Torpedo and Lightning God Spear Strike while linking; Deep Rising (Lv 160) is a 45 second cooldown invincibility of a few seconds that can be linked into and out of. Sources: https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Thunder_Breaker/Skills and https://docs.google.com/document/d/149bORdBFd99UJSFbza52zv5AJw4VfB4kvqC5p4K-97g/mobilebasic

innerAbility.notes: Attack speed is not listed as an inner ability target for this class by any source read. Grandis Library's base-stat table shows Thunder Breaker reaching attack speed 8 on its own at Lightning Elemental stage 5, with Speed Infusion adding +2 more without breaking the soft cap - which would explain why no source recommends the attack speed line, but no source says so explicitly, so this is flagged as an inference rather than sourced advice. Source: https://grandislibrary.com/cygnus-knights/thunder-breaker

gearingNotes: What the class supplies itself, which is what determines where gear, legion and hyper stat points should go (Grandis Library base-stats-from-skills table): weapon multiplier 1.7x; attack speed 8 at Lightning Elemental stage 5 plus +2 from Speed Infusion that does not break the soft cap; weapon mastery 90%; STR +60 and +1 per 2 levels plus 15% of assigned AP; attack +14% and +170 flat (up to +210); critical rate +40%; critical damage +30%; damage +40% base rising to +122% with conditional sources; BOSS DAMAGE +0% from passives; final damage about +49% base rising to +89% conditionally; ignore DEF +45%, up to 50% while Primal Bolt is active. Consequences drawn from those numbers plus the class doc: (1) critical rate is the stat a Thunder Breaker is most likely to be short of early, and the doc's answer is the Xenon link, swapping in Lynn or Phantom links until gear and legion cover it; (2) with zero boss damage from passives, boss damage must come from gear, legion, inner ability and hyper stats; (3) the doc's Legion Grid order is critical rate as needed, then boss damage, critical damage, ignore DEF, STR, attack power, buff duration (only when running the Angelic Buster link), DEX; its Legion Artifact order is critical rate / boss damage / damage, then ignore DEF / all stats / critical damage, then attack power / buff duration / cooldown skip, with EXP / drop rate / meso obtained as the training alternative; (4) cooldown-reduction hat: the doc says most Thunder Breakers run a -2 second, 2-line-stat hat while some prefer 3 lines of stat, that cooldown reduction affects Gale/Typhoon, Shark Torpedo, Lightning God Spear Strike and all burst buffs including the skill ring, and that a casual player should keep whichever they roll first; (5) ring choice: as a sustained-DPM class Continuous Ring is better in the abstract, but Ring of Restraint wins on bosses where 100% uptime is impossible such as Kalos or Kaling - the doc notes this becomes moot in a future patch allowing a passive and an active ring together. Sources: https://grandislibrary.com/cygnus-knights/thunder-breaker and https://docs.google.com/document/d/149bORdBFd99UJSFbza52zv5AJw4VfB4kvqC5p4K-97g/mobilebasic

commonMistakes.mistake: Using the in-game macro to combo. It does not work with Thunder Breaker's linking system.
Pressing the same attack twice in a row instead of linking two different skills. Repeating one skill incurs heavy end-lag between casts.
Casting Gale/Typhoon or Shark Torpedo below 5 Lightning Elemental stacks. The doc says to fire both only at max stacks.
Linking Lightning Spear Multistrike into other skills or holding the key down. Its 12 casts are pressed back to back on their own.
Wasting Lightning Brands. A brand applied by HEXA Annihilate is consumed by the next non-Annihilate attack, so Gale/Typhoon and Shark Torpedo should be woven in directly after an Annihilate.
Never upgrading Empress Cygnus's Blessing. Talking to Neinheart in Moonbridge after the questline upgrades it to the Transcendent version, which adds damage reduction for the buff's duration.
Burning fragments rerolling HEXA Stat main stats before the HEXA Matrix is finished.
Mashing harder or faster expecting more attacks. The doc states it does not produce more damage and covers keybinding and wrist-strain mitigation instead.

evidenceNote: HONEST SOURCING VERDICT: three independent sources were reached, but only two of them carry judgement, and one of those two is nearly two years old. The judgement lanes are (1) the Thunder Breaker Discord family - the C0nfeddie class doc, that Discord's 2026-09-04 infographics, and Grandis Library, which credits the Discord by name and therefore does NOT count as a second opinion - and (2) mastermysty's 2024-11-21 node table. The third independent source, maplestorywiki, is facts only and is used here to validate every node and skill name so nothing in this file is invented. Reddit could not be read in this environment and NamuWiki's Striker page was blocked by Cloudflare, so the KMS cross-check is missing; the web search budget was exhausted and DuckDuckGo began serving a CAPTCHA, so no YouTube-creator pass was possible. Everything marked weak should be surfaced to users as single-source. The two biggest gaps: no hyper stat ranking exists for this class anywhere public, and the HEXA investment order exists only as an image.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: The Xenon link claim is an inversion of the source. The class doc says 'If you're early in the game and lacking crit rate, feel free to swap out Xenon link for Lynn/Phantom link as needed' - Xenon is removed, Lynn/Phantom supply crit rate. The file states the reverse in hyperStats.notes ('should use the Xenon link and may swap in Lynn or Phantom links') and gearingNotes item 1 ('the doc's answer is the Xenon link'). Independently wrong too: Xenon's link is all-stat %, not critical rate. No source states what the file states.

vMatrix.notes assigns the Tidal Crash / Sea Wave / Shark Sweep node to Grandis Library's SECONDARY tier. Grandis tiers it OTHER; only Gale/Typhoon/Deep Rising is SECONDARY. The file also quotes Grandis' rule that Primary and Secondary are the ones worth upgrading - so corrected, Grandis says this node is NOT worth building while the class doc ranks it 8th. A real conflict was converted into agreement and left out of conflicts[]. The file's own conflicts[0] contradicts its notes field on this point.

The 2026-09-04 infographic date is asserted four times (hexa.order step 1, sources[] entries, evidenceNote) as metadata 'recorded by Grandis Library alongside the image'. Two separate fetches of the Grandis page report no dates anywhere on the page beyond the GMS Ver. 269 stamp, and the PNG carries no printed date. Unsupported, and load-bearing: it is the only basis for treating the Discord's 6th job advice as current and for the 'metadata tension' conflict entry.
